title: Document exhaustive subtitle handling review
summary: Adds a review-only subtitle handling audit packet covering ASS/SSA, TX3G, BDPGS/OCR, VobSub/OCR, SRT creation, language filtering, preservation defaults, supplemental subtitle rules, OCR tool paths, conversion failures, review routing, sidecar handling, and silent-drop risks.
reason: The operator requested a full subtitle handling review with explicit findings and remediation planning, and AGENTS.md requires meaningful agent-authored documentation changes to be covered by a structured change packet.
behavior_before: No dedicated exhaustive subtitle handling review packet existed under docs/reviews for the requested ASS, TX3G, BDPGS/OCR, SRT, language filtering, preservation, supplemental, sidecar, and silent-drop scope.
behavior_after: docs/reviews/subtitle-handling-2026-06-16 contains the requested nine review artifacts and this change packet records the docs-only review evidence.
manual_validation: Inspected required generated summaries before opening full subtitle, publish, config, UI, QA, and test source files.
ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-SrtValidationChecks.ps1 - failed before assertions because the harness resolved ops/ops/pipeline/engine/subtitles/srt.ps1.
ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-FileOverrideSubtitleBurnChecks.ps1 - failed before assertions because the harness resolved ops/ops/pipeline/engine/queue/file_overrides.ps1.
Real-media OCR/playback validation was not run because this was a no-code review packet.
notes: Docs-only review. No runtime source, media policy, queue, publish, OCR, or sidecar behavior was changed. Highest-severity review finding is MP4 compatibility reducing multiple converted subtitle candidates to one external SRT without durable per-track review/failure evidence.
